description: Assistant should tolerate a short tangent, then gently return to the recurring avoidance pattern within a couple of turns.

session_context.notes: Avoids hard conversations and lets tension build up.
session_context.direction: Help the client name what they are avoiding and what feels hardest about it.

ai_kps.headline: Avoidance loop
ai_kps.body: Keeps postponing difficult conversations, then feels worse as the issue grows.

user_turns: My weekend was fine, just normal really.
I guess there is one conversation I've been avoiding again.
expected_behaviors: Lets the tangent pass without overcommitting to it
Moves toward the avoidance theme once the user opens that door
forbidden_behaviors: Gets stuck on the weekend tangent
Misses the avoidance theme after the third user turn
